summary: Nora now reconnects and resumes Discord music sessions after a restart, as long as someone is still in the voice channel.
details: On boot, every persisted session (design/discord-music/06-session-persistence.md's stage 1) is checked: if its voice channel still has a human in it, Nora rejoins and restarts the track that was playing (from the beginning, not mid-song), reapplying volume and pause state, then continues into the rest of the queue normally.
If the channel is empty, or no longer exists, the stale session is discarded instead -- Nora never silently rejoins and plays into an empty room after a deploy.
A resumed session posts a silent "Now playing" notification in the channel it originally started from, same as any other auto-advance.
limitations: Playback position within the interrupted track is never resumed -- only which track, not where in it.
